body.asks: What was found reading the git reader. Mended on 2026-11-11, in Mending the edges and The git reader's faults: failures refused in words, an unborn HEAD read as none, tags peeled whole, a HEAD naming a tag peeled to its commit; objects read through one cat-file kept running while reads come and ended when none waits, a blob known by its size with its bytes passed over, one restarted where it ends; everything in a tenth of a second, the tip's tree in one ls-tree, the tip the tree of HEAD's own commit; a submodule's entry pointing at what is not here and holding nothing; a ref naming a tree or a blob saying so, naming no commit. Left: ref and type ids by name collide across repositories, waiting on a git store's root and the author's word; a moving ref shows no new version and nothing renews the source when git's refs move; a remote's refs are left out, as that remote's.
